taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-07 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1790.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 384.0 | 1.63 | 2.15
3 | 73.0 | 22.70 | 24.85
4 | 103.4 | 11.48 | 36.33
5 | 540.2 | 1.37 | 37.70
6 | 520.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as QHAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-07
Curve type: QHAA
Aquifer depth: 2.15 m – 24.85 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity (≈73 ohm-m) layer between about 2.2 m and 24.9 m depth as the primary water-bearing zone; set casing through the upper overburden layers and screen the borehole across this interval, extending drilling slightly beyond 25 m to confirm the base of the aquifer before finalizing completion depth.
